dataset_root_convention: ${IU_XRAY_STORAGE_ROOT} resolves to <Google Drive mount>/FactMM-RAG-Enhanced/data/iu_xray when Google Drive is mounted at /content/drive/MyDrive, otherwise <REPO_ROOT>/data/iu_xray (see this script's Part 0 for the exact detection logic each run performs).
note: Lightweight, Git-eligible index only. The complete canonical manifest (all per-record fields, no image bytes) lives outside Git at the path given by dataset_root_convention + full_manifest_external_path (a portable, symbolic reference); full_manifest_external_path_resolved_this_run is the literal absolute path for this specific run only, informational, not meant to be portable. split_manifest_reference names the sibling Git-tracked file (in this same results/reproduction/milestone_2_8/ directory) holding the train/validation/test study_id assignment for these records.
